Container.Name: Docket
Container.Overview:
Docket is a self-hosted, multi-project social scheduler and LLM post generator for Facebook Pages, Instagram, Threads and Bluesky.
Queue, schedule and publish posts from a calendar, draft them with OpenAI or Anthropic, and automate it all through a REST API with webhooks.
Requires an external PostgreSQL database. This template runs the web app and the scheduler in one container (RUN_WORKER_IN_PROCESS=true). Database migrations run on start. On first visit, /setup creates the first account.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL container (Docket is tested on PostgreSQL 17). Install the official "postgres" template from Community Applications, create a database named "docket" with a dedicated user, and paste the connection string into Database URL below. Back up the Credentials Encryption Key somewhere safe: without it, connected accounts must all be reconnected.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Docket web UI. Keep it on your LAN or behind a reverse proxy; never forward it directly to the internet.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. Example: postgres://docket:password@192.168.1.100:5432/docket

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: The exact address people type into the browser: scheme, host and port, no path. A mismatch breaks sign-in. Examples: http://192.168.1.100:3000 or https://docket.example.com. Threads needs https:// on a real domain.

Config.Name: Auth Secret
Config.Description: Signs session cookies; at least 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Credentials Encryption Key
Config.Description: Encrypts stored account credentials: 32 bytes as base64 (44 characters) or hex (64). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. BACK THIS UP: losing it means reconnecting every account.

Config.Name: Run Scheduler In Web Container
Config.Description: Keep true. The scheduler publishes due posts every minute; with false, nothing publishes unless you run a separate worker container (command: node worker.mjs) or an external cron.

Config.Name: S3 Bucket
Config.Description: Media storage (photos). Leave all S3 fields empty to disable uploads; set all four to enable. Works with Cloudflare R2, AWS S3 or another S3-compatible store. The bucket must be publicly reachable: see docs/storage.md.

Config.Name: S3 Access Key ID
Config.Description: Media storage access key id.

Config.Name: S3 Secret Access Key
Config.Description: Media storage secret access key.

Config.Name: S3 Public Base URL
Config.Description: Public https:// address media is served from, e.g. an R2 custom domain: https://media.example.com

Config.Name: S3 Endpoint
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty for AWS. R2: https://ACCOUNT_ID.r2.cloudflarestorage.com

Config.Name: S3 Region
Config.Description: Optional. Empty means auto (right for R2). For AWS, the bucket's region.

Config.Name: LLM Provider
Config.Description: Optional. openai or anthropic. Leave empty (with the other LLM fields) to turn the post generator off. See docs/generator.md.

Config.Name: LLM Model
Config.Description: Model id your provider account can use; required when LLM Provider is set.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Required when LLM Provider is openai.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Required when LLM Provider is anthropic.

Config.Name: Meta App ID
Config.Description: Optional. Facebook Pages and Instagram. Set with Meta App Secret; register APP_URL/connect/callback in the Meta app. See docs/meta-setup.md.

Config.Name: Meta App Secret
Config.Description: Optional. Set with Meta App ID.

Config.Name: Threads App ID
Config.Description: Optional. Threads. Set with Threads App Secret. Needs an https:// App URL that is not localhost.

Config.Name: Threads App Secret
Config.Description: Optional. Set with Threads App ID.

Config.Name: Trusted IP Headers
Config.Description: Optional. Behind a reverse proxy: comma-separated header names holding the real client IP, e.g. x-real-ip. Set with Trusted Proxies so rate limits see visitors, not the proxy.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxies
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated IPs or CIDR ranges of your reverse proxy, e.g. 172.17.0.0/16.

Config.Name: Allow Mock Provider
Config.Description: Optional. true lets you connect an offline Mock account to try Docket without real social accounts. Leave empty for real use.
